intro.text: Flights from Auckland to Sydney run from Auckland Airport (AKL) to Sydney (Kingsford Smith) Airport (SYD). Airlines flying the route include Jetstar and Qantas.

sections.heading: What should you know about nonstop Auckland–Sydney service?

paragraphs.text: LATAM announced the termination of its direct service between Sydney and Santiago via Auckland.

sections.heading: How do you get to and from the airports?

paragraphs.text: The orange AirportLink bus service carries passengers between Auckland Airport, Puhinui Station and Manukau Bus Station.
